item.subject: science
item.stem: In a class activity, Meena lists four jobs done in the stomach: (1) churning food by wall movements, (2) breaking down proteins, (3) killing many harmful bacteria, (4) protecting the stomach lining. She must match each job to the correct secretion or action. Which matching is correct?

options.A: 1 – mucus, 2 – acid, 3 – digestive juice enzymes, 4 – churning
options.B: 1 – wall movements, 2 – digestive juice enzymes, 3 – acid, 4 – mucus
options.C: 1 – wall movements, 2 – acid, 3 – mucus, 4 – digestive juice enzymes
options.D: 1 – digestive juice enzymes, 2 – wall movements, 3 – mucus, 4 – acid
